dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Wow, look at all these people! And they're all here to play cards? Hehe, the atmosphere's pretty infectious! Makes me wanna play a few rounds too...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Ah, shoot! I gotta get back to my training... Got a contest coming up in a few days! See ya later!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Yay, I won! Now, to celebrate, let's have some cake! I wasn't supposed to buy any, though, so don't tell Coach Iansan!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Whew, I'm actually feeling kinda dizzy. Did I overdo the warm-up or something? No, that can't be it... I followed Coach Iansan's instructions to the letter.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: A game of cards? Sure, why not! Most of my time is spent training, so I don't get a lot of practice, but... I'll give it my all!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I won, hehe! But all that strategizing's got me hungry... Let's go grab something to eat!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: *sigh* I lost. Guess I didn't eat enough earlier, after all... Should've grabbed a few extra steaks.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Coach Iansan always says working out helps you focus better... So, let me just get a few push-ups in before we start!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: That was a close one! Good thing I was thinking on my feet — those push-ups must've worked!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: *sigh* One little slip-up and it's game over... Wanna play another round? I won't fall for the same tactic twice, y'know!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
